model.name: qwen3-coder-next-q4km
model.about: Alibaba Qwen3-Coder-Next, mixture of experts (80B, about 3B active; hybrid linear and full attention), Q4_K_M GGUF as published by Qwen, served with llama.cpp. Apache-2.0. About 48 GB, so one A100. Instruct only, no thinking. llama.cpp cannot force a named tool, so the agent's last 'submit now' request runs with tool_choice auto.

SELECT
  j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
  COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE a.BUS_DT_K IN (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
)
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE atm.BUS_DT_K >= 20250101
  AND atm.BUS_DT_K <= 20251231
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dflt.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dflt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dflt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dflt.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
  d_ccy.ccy_cd1 AS currency_code,
  AVG(f_rt.mid_rt) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f_rt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f_rt.ccy_k = d_ccy.ccy_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_rt.bus_dt_k = d_dt.dt_k
WHERE d_dt.cal_dt >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d_dt.cal_dt < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY d_ccy.ccy_cd1
ORDER BY d_ccy.ccy_cd1;

SELECT
  d_br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE
  d_dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d_dt.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY d_br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY d_br.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.BUS_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31';

WITH atm_txns_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND dt.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND br.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    txn_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_count DESC, branch_name ASC) AS rn
  FROM atm_txns_2025
)
SELECT
  region_code,
  branch_name,
  txn_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;
